title: Institutional Rule Layer Schema
description: Schema for specific institutional internal rules, separated from the general legal master registry.

rule_id.description: Unique identifier for the institutional rule.

rule_name.description: Official name of the internal rule (e.g., '계약사무처리규정').

base_jurisdiction.description: The primary master jurisdiction this institution falls back to.

review_status.description: Verification status of the rule. Defaults to needs_review upon ingestion.

active_for_rule.description: Whether this rule is active and can be referenced by the Rule Engine. False until verified.
